label: De ente root-interface controls (inference)
rule: Explicit finite and infinite interpretations, checked by case analysis and accessibility proofs
meaning: Closed controls for the #1635 root interface and per se regress: the per se bridge (per accidens regress), the ground bridge (non-causal ground), the concreteness bridge (absent source), no self-causation (self-ground), and one interpretation satisfying every input and conclusion.
